name: Harenohi Yuki
source:
A tall, good-looking, and refreshing third-year student, who attends a different school from [url=/c133400]Hashigo[/url] and [url=/c133398]Shizuku[/url]. He has both cheerful and calm sides, and is popular with everyone. At the "Meetup Event for People with Feathers," which he held, he calls himself "Soda." Since he has left his parents and lived alone independently, Hashigo thinks of him as his role model. However, on occasion, he appears to be haunted by the shadow of a woman....

The feather in his possession is called "Glacies."
